name: USD / INR (dollar to rupee)
description: How many rupees one US dollar buys. A higher number means a weaker rupee. The rupee strengthened from 96.72 on 9 October to 94.89 on 16 October before slipping slightly on 19 October.
source: Interbank foreign exchange market, provisional close
releaseSchedule: Trades continuously; month-end reference rate shown here.
